name: Confetti Button
description: A button that bursts confetti from its own position on click to celebrate signups, purchases and other success moments.
usage: Render <ConfettiButton>Sign up</ConfettiButton> wherever you want a celebratory click; on press it reads its own bounding rect, normalises the centre to viewport-origin coordinates and fires canvas-confetti from that exact spot. Tune particleCount, spread, angle, startVelocity, gravity, scalar and colors, and use onConfetti for follow-up logic.
